verdict.rationale: Signifyd's docs describe official SDKs, but only for mobile app developers: self-contained libraries with instructions, examples, and project files. Its core integration (Checkout, Sale, Get Decision, chargebacks, webhooks) is documented only as a raw REST API, with no server-side or language SDKs shown. Missing for 10: official server-side/backend language SDKs covering the core REST API, details on which languages and platforms are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
